frequency_question: How often do Federal Reserve policy statements that adjust bank capital buffers explicitly specify an increase above 0% in the countercyclical capital buffer rather than other capital instruments?
membership_rule: Includes any Federal Reserve Board of Governors official press release or FOMC statement concerning capital buffers. Excludes general speeches, supervisory guidance not formatted as official board announcements, and Basel III implementation proposals without final board votes.
coverage_note: 5 major capital framework and rate decision events identified; covers all relevant formal Board announcement cycles since 1994.
known_gaps: Excludes minor technical corrections and inter-agency staff memos not resulting in Board votes.
skeleton: Regulatory capital announcement cycles since 1994, decomposed into major framework updates and recurring rate-setting decision cycles.
multiplier: 5 major formal rule-making and rate announcement cycles identified where capital buffer thresholds were formally addressed.
validity_reason: Regulatory frameworks for bank capital and the mechanisms of Fed press releases change slowly over decades.
